lockup.summary: The company, its directors and officers, and holders of almost all its stock cannot sell for at least 180 days after the prospectus date. The lead underwriters can give written consent to sell sooner, and some exceptions apply.

what: A clinical-stage biotech developing oral drugs that block NLRP3, a protein that drives inflammation in heart and brain diseases.
risks: Rezera is a young biotech with no drug sales, has lost money since it began, and may never make a profit.
Its recurring losses raise serious doubt that it can keep operating as a going concern.
None of its drug candidates is approved yet, and delays or failure to bring them to market would badly hurt the business.
Changes in currency exchange rates could raise its costs and use up its cash faster.
Its drugs target NLRP3, a new target, so development time, cost and chance of success are hard to predict.
